name: Tinkle Poetry
original_name: てぃんくるぽえとりー
source:
Main character returns to his home town where he had many precious memories. He meets a beautiful child Nagisa, and the two have sex due to a misunderstanding. Young people become lovers, but protagonist also seeks for the past love of his memories.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
